title: Named partial skill snapshot
summary: Validate named skill grouping without claiming completeness when a referenced file is missing.
why_it_works: The missing local reference prevents a complete-package claim, even when the submitted skill file was fully inspected. The inert HTTP reference keeps the snapshot visible in findings-only report views.
mitigations: Inspect missing references before making a completeness claim.
Do not interpret a content fingerprint or self-declared name as approval.
